notes: Site is anthropologie.com/en-gb/ (genuine distinct UK storefront per prior pass's duplicate-company check, re-confirmed: /en-gb/ pages render natively in GBP). Access: DataDome-protected. Direct HTTP (curl_cffi impersonate='chrome124') worked for a handful of requests then the whole IP got DataDome-CAPTCHA-blocked (confirmed via robots.txt allowed, but /en-gb/* pages 403 with a DataDome challenge page) for both curl_cffi (all impersonation profiles) and Playwright/CDP -- same egress, so tier 2 was blocked too. Completed the extraction via Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3, last resort) using the user's real Chrome session, which was not blocked. robots.txt carries no Claude/anthropic-ai disallow. Scoped to Home department only (site sells Clothing/Dresses/Petite/Shoes/Accessories/Weddings/Beauty in addition to Home & Decor and Furniture) -- both 'Home & Decor' and 'Furniture' top-nav departments were checked as 'Home'. The plain /en-gb/bestsellers URL (present in the sitemap) is DEAD -- it loads with title 'Anthro Icons' but the body reads 'Sorry, the category you're looking for cannot be found.' (confirmed by screenshot) -- so that URL was excluded and home-anthro-classics (found via live nav) was used as the canonical link. /en-gb/bestsellers-fashion (573 products) exists but is explicitly Fashion-scoped, excluded as out of Home-department scope. Checked the Furniture department for an equivalent Furniture Bestsellers listing: no 'Shop by Category' dropdown exists on the Furniture landing page, and the categories sitemap has no furniture-bestsellers/classics-style URL -- only /en-gb/top-rated-furniture, which is a customer-ratings ('Top Rated') page, not a genuine sales-popularity Bestsellers PLP per the badge-vs-listing test in the brief, so it was excluded. No local-language variants needed (UK/English site). No genuine sub-structure under Home Bestsellers itself (no further category chips inside that listing).
